name: Water Engineering
description: Characteristics of water-physical, chemical and biological; conventional and emerging pollutants in different sources of water; water chemistry- acid-base equilibrium, solubility and precipitation, complex ions; reaction kinetics and thermodynamics, types of reactors, unit operation and processes, fundamental principles of water treatment- sedimentation, settling theory, Stoke's law; coagulation, colloidal stability, DLVO theory; filtration-types of filters; disinfection-CT concept; hardness removal, water stabilization; advanced water treatment- adsorption-kinetics and isotherm, breakthrough curve, ion exchange, membrane processes and principles, advanced oxidation processes and mechanisms of pollutant degradation, electrodialysis and capacitive deionization. Selection of treatment scheme-design considerations.
